changes.result: Added a std-only build script classifier that derives the source list solely from plugin-manifest-draft.json, recursively inspects the exact real templates tree without following links, rejects any symlink, multi-link file, FIFO, socket, device, directory substitution, cross-device object, invalid mode, oversized object, duplicate, alias, unknown, omitted, extra, or reordered source, then performs nonblocking no-follow open, stable double read, and path-plus-handle identity revalidation before staging private OUT_DIR copies. Generation and direct staging erase both authority-bearing output paths before any validation, after the inspection hook, and on every returned error or caught panic. Cleanup failure suppresses the underlying validation error. After staging, the generator re-enumerates the complete file-and-directory tree, requires exact original identities, writes the staged manifest, and only then emits the rustc catalog.

Bound the exact 68 manifest-authorized template byte slices and Unix modes into a bounded deterministic DesiredState for the current LiveContext and candidate, rejecting path aliases, special sources, duplicate, missing, unknown, reordered, oversized, and manifest-drift inputs.
Added inspect, plan, and verify machine projections with exact target, candidate, root, authority, desired-state, inspection, mutation, conflict, rollback, mode, and causal verification identities.

Added one canonical bounded plan-record parser that recomputes the current plan, compares the exact accepted digest, and returns a non-Clone opaque request without performing an effect or issuing root authority.

Added descriptor-anchored, no-follow, same-device, exact-case compare-exchange effects using RENAME_EXCL and RENAME_SWAP, authoritative 07777-mode verification, identity-conditioned quarantine, bounded cleanup, rollback, and race refusal. Production construction has no mutation lease.

Added crate-private fit inspect, plan, verify, and apply-preparation handlers while leaving successor_public/mod.rs, the sole dispatcher, command witnesses, root permit, and effect execution untouched.

findings.finding: Independent re-review prepopulated both OUT_DIR authority paths and supplied a real source symlink. The generated catalog was removed, but source inspection failed before staging cleanup and stale embedded bytes survived. Generate and direct stage now prove both paths absent before validation and after every error or caught panic; if that proof cannot be established, only the cleanup failure is returned.

Independent re-review showed that staging consumed the initial observed map and never re-enumerated the complete real source tree, so a persistent extra path added by the post-inspection hook could false-pass. Staging now ends with a stable exact re-enumeration of every file and directory against the original identities, and every parity failure erases staged output before generated catalog emission.

Independent review showed that hardcoded production rows always labeled sources Regular and direct include_bytes could follow symlinks and hardlinks or block on a FIFO before runtime validation. Production rows now exist only after real source classification, stable staging, and generated private-copy embedding.

The live candidate files were not compiled until repository_fit and local declared and crate-privately reexported the product adapter and LocalEffects. The requested minimal wiring now compiles and passes the focused and dependency-closure controls.

The candidate public fit adapter originally imported repository_fit::product_adapter directly, which a sibling module cannot access after root wiring. It now imports only the requested crate-private repository_fit reexports.
No successor_public module declaration or sole-dispatcher branch imports this candidate, so public command behavior and production compilation of fit.rs remain unproven.
